decisions.reason: The Big Block ticket rules from message 21 are already fully represented by its same-message MODIFY; no additional propagation is needed.
The ticket eligibility and reset rules belong to the Small Block ticket lifecycle; the prize amount, winner count, activation condition, and other draw attributes remain valid.
Message 21 explicitly leaves random allocation when no referral is used unchanged.
The metadata consequence is already fully captured by the same-message INTRODUCE requiring the two ticket counters and permanent badges.
Secondary royalties remain enabled and continue funding the prize pools; their non-generation of tickets is already represented by the ticket lifecycle requirements.
The Small Block ticket lifecycle change does not alter the Big Block prize amount, winner count, or draw trigger, which is already captured by its same-message MODIFY.
Message 21 explicitly states that manual claim remains unchanged.
The automatic $5 commission allocation is explicitly left unchanged by the ticket lifecycle adjustment.
The client explicitly preserves the automatic $5 referral commission without changing its amount or payout mode.
The change governs ticket issuance, eligibility windows, and reset behavior; it does not alter random winner selection or ticket-weighted probability.
The ticket lifecycle adjustment has no semantic effect on project naming or branding.
